## Scope

- What problem does this change solve?
- Which calculation, contract, or user workflow changes?
- What is explicitly out of scope?

## Evidence

- [ ] analytical or independently calculated fixture added/updated
- [ ] domain invariants and failure paths covered
- [ ] units, signs, timestamps, currencies, and tolerances reviewed
- [ ] input/output schema and model version impact assessed
- [ ] documentation and limitations match behavior
- [ ] only fictional or redistributable data included
- [ ] CI is green with no unresolved high-severity finding

## Reproduction

Provide the exact command, input hash, expected result, and relevant solver metadata.
